agent_signals_extension.get_metric_percentile: Read-only nearest-rank estimator shared with personal floors, explicit exclusive reference date; missing history -> None, storage failure raises. stress_high_min includes zero. Existing personalizer callers retain their default window.
agent_signals_extension.get_recent_labs: Existing facade delegates to labs_db. Optional n_days=None removes the lower date bound; reference_date caps history. Default exclusion of PRO also filters score units before latest-row grouping.
agent_signals_extension.upsert_config: Existing facade delegates to config_db. Optional conn preserves caller transaction ownership and rollback; omitted conn retains autonomous write behavior.

sleep_read_contract.read: get_day reconstructs sleep from daily_metrics sleep columns only when raw.sleep is absent/empty. Hours stay hours; missing stages are None. source is AppleHealth when the Apple witness matches total, otherwise flat. Existing raw.sleep is unchanged.
sleep_read_contract.write: AppleHealth sleep updates replace prior Apple flat values, never a present raw.sleep block. Non-null fields only. Repeated identical imports are idempotent.
sleep_read_contract.late_data: get_day reads current SQLite data on every call. Replacing partial Apple sleep makes the next consumer see fresh data without a dirty flag, report rewrite, or automatic resend.
sleep_read_contract.archive: Daily JSON format is unchanged. migrate_all_json passes the complete payload once: Oura if source=Oura, sleep has contributors or source=Oura, or an Oura-only key is present (readiness_score, resilience, stress, hrv_balance, body_temperature, recovery_index, breathing_disturbance); otherwise AppleHealth. It does not repair previously mislabelled database rows.
sleep_read_contract.failures: Database writes roll back together. Importer logs SQLite failures and retains the source archive for replay. JSON archive and SQLite are not a cross-store atomic transaction.
